# 1. Reform Six Ministries & Grand Secretariat (one-time institutional overhaul)
oe_mg2_dec_reform_six_ministries = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		oe_mg2_is_host = yes
		current_year >= 1425
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_dec_six_ministries_done }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mg2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 220
		stability >= 0
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_mg2_dec_reform_six_ministries.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_mg2_dec_reform_six_ministries_tt
			oe_mg2_init_host = yes
			add_gold = -220
			set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_dec_six_ministries_done value = 1 }
			oe_mg2_add_cabinet = { amt = 20 }
			add_stability = 5
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_mg2_mod_reformed_six_ministries years = 35 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# 2. Purge Factional Corruption & Eastern Depot Abuses (repeatable, 12y cooldown)
oe_mg2_dec_purge_factional_corruption = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_mg2_is_host = yes
		current_year >= 1445
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mg2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 160
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mg2_purge_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_purge_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:burghers_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_mg2_dec_purge_factional_corruption.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_mg2_dec_purge_factional_corruption_tt
			oe_mg2_init_host = yes
			add_gold = -160
			set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_purge_cd value = 1 years = 12 }
			if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mg2_mod_eastern_depot_terror } remove_country_modifier = oe_mg2_mod_eastern_depot_terror }
			if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mg2_mod_mine_tax_extortion } remove_country_modifier = oe_mg2_mod_mine_tax_extortion }
			oe_mg2_add_cabinet = { amt = 15 }
			oe_mg2_add_uprising = { amt = -20 }
			add_stability = 5
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_mg2_mod_clean_censorate years = 15 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# 3. Rally Southern Ming Loyalists & Maritime Fleets (repeatable, 12y cooldown)
oe_mg2_dec_rally_southern_loyalists = {
	decision_category = country_specific_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_mg2_is_host = yes
		current_year >= 1620
		oe_mg2_holds_south_bastion = yes
		OR = {
			oe_mg2_northern_capital_lost = yes
			has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_mg2_late_ming_uprising
			oe_mg2_late_ming_distress = yes
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mg2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 140
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mg2_loyalist_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_loyalist_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:burghers } }
	option = {
		name = oe_mg2_dec_rally_southern_loyalists.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_mg2_dec_rally_southern_loyalists_tt

			add_navy_tradition = 8
